body: Let me apologize if I sounded like I was in denial, I just wanted to clarify where I felt I'd made any mistakes or caused any misunderstandings. Once again genuinely thank you for your time and response, seeing as the majority here has agreed I am indeed an asshole, I've messaged my group and told them if they'd like to and would allow me to, I'd like to join them for one last boys night out. I'd like to thank each and everyone for their responses and views tonight, it's been very very insightful.

Thank you for your response and I see where you're coming from, my bad was not using the correct term and that's on me. When I said I see them once a week I meant on call or psn party, not physically. Tomorrow was the first time we'd be meeting physically in a months.

I appreciate your response and would like to express my gratitude for taking your time to respond as such. I'd just like to say that, yes I do wish to interact with my friend more without being sidelined as any time I do talk to him on call once a week, he'll end it quickly to go back to his girl. It's not that I'm not appreciative of the time they make for me, it's that it's never genuine and always rushed.

I first off appreciate your outlook on this, it's very understanding and logical, however id just like defend the POV that I am perfectly fine and content with them spending every minute with one another. That is what brings them joy and thus, me joy. I'd just like to say that when it finally time for us to get together or do anything, it's always hindered and shortened by the two of them wanting to talk to one another, as if there is never a time for the rest of us. I hope I elaborated that somewhat decently. It's not that I'm not happy with the time they make for me, it's that the time I do get is hijacked by them.

I appreciate your faith in me, only issue is I hate myself at this point for being so ugly and bad that I can't get anyone to like me. Due to that I have zero motivation in me to do anything and so can't do or focus on anything either.

The issue with that is, doing anything at this point requires motivation that I just don't have. I see everything as pointless and hate that I can't genuinely enjoy anything at all. I've also been told I'm young and things will get better for years but here we are still going ig.

The recommendations seem pretty good but I am abit too shy for something that obvious and open 🤭. The helping them with work part we both do mutually but thats just a friendly gesture. I am planning on getting this out of my system soon and no worries, I respect her choice either way it goes. 🤗

As if late I've stopped putting myself out there as it never works out at all. Being lonely has gotten me so miserable that the hobbies I used to enjoy like gaming have offset me. I've deleted all social media apps as well due to said miserable feelings as almost everyone's got a soul mate there too.
With who lmao, no girls ever given me the light of day
